title: Keycloak Operator
description: The vendored upstream Keycloak Operator: its Deployment, RBAC and the two Keycloak CRDs. The root stays OPEN, and `global` is declared explicitly: Krateo's chart-inspector injects Helm's reserved `global` key at install time, which a closed schema would reject.

global.description: Helm's reserved global values, injected by the platform at install time.

watchNamespaces.title: Watched namespaces
watchNamespaces.description: Namespace(s) the operator reconciles: one name, a comma-separated list, or JOSDK_WATCH_ALL for cluster-wide.

keycloakImage.title: Keycloak server image
keycloakImage.description: The Keycloak image the operator deploys for Keycloak CRs (upstream RELATED_IMAGE_KEYCLOAK).

failureThreshold.description: Raise on CPU- or memory-constrained nodes (upstream ships 3; 30 gives the operator ~5 minutes).

crdOwnershipBridge.description: Post-install/post-upgrade Job stamping this release's Helm ownership on the two CRDs (the bridge to the release that renders them from templates/).
